title: Valley Biz Blog: Free Gift Cards to ULTA Beauty in Harlingen
description: The first 100 customers at the new ULTA Beauty in Harlingen will get FREE gift cards worth up to $100 dollars. For more information head to our website: http://www.valleycentral.com.

asr.full_text: Tomorrow we're going to have our grand opening on Friday, Saturday, and Sunday. And we're going to have 100 free gift cards for the first 100 guests. With denominations between $5 and $100. Tell us about these gift cards now. It's going to be random? You don't even know? We don't even know. They just get to pick a gift card and it could be any denomination. So it's by luck. So by luck. So one lucky person could potentially get... $100. $100. And what does $100 get you here at Ulta? Oh, we can get you a big array of products. We carry all sorts of prestige cosmetics, mask cosmetics, hair care, skin care, and fragrances. But you'll also do more. Don't you have a salon back here somewhere? Yes, we do. We have a full-service salon, and we do haircuts, color, styles, waxing, and facials. And does Ulta always do this at the opening of a new store? Is this something, or is it just for here in Harlingen? No, absolutely. We do that for all our grand openings. We currently have 696 locations and we open basically one a month of locations. So we're very excited about being part of the community in Harlington. What about Texas in the Valley? What's your presence here? Right now we have one location in McAllen, Texas. This is going to be our second location here in Rio Grande Valley. And we have a location also in Laredo, Texas. Overnight campers. Can we expect any? I'm hoping, we've read on Facebook that we are going to have some overnight campers being here at 6 a.m. in the morning. So we're expecting that. So hopefully it will be. You mean you all have a local Facebook page for this store? We have a nationwide Facebook page for Ulta,. And they were invited to come to our store to take part of our grand opening. And that's Friday, Saturday, and Sunday, first 100 customers. Yes, absolutely, Friday, Saturday, and Sunday.

annotation.contextual_rationale: This video is non-scam content because it is a local business segment about an Ulta Beauty grand opening and an ordinary in-store gift-card giveaway for early customers. The described promotion involves random gift-card denominations for the first 100 guests and discusses the store's cosmetics, hair care, fragrances, and salon services. the available video evidence also states that there is no advance payment request, private-information request, financial participation, or off-platform step tied to receiving the gift cards.
annotation.fine_grained_rationale: The central observed mechanism is an ordinary retail giveaway: free gift cards are offered to the first 100 guests, with the denomination determined by luck. The supplied evidence does not link the gift cards to an external claim, survey, purchase, verification, or information-submission flow.
